what: When the command compacts its conversation during a chat run (stream event system / compact_boundary), a notice goes into that chat (POST /api/v1/agent/chats/{id} with kind notice: one small grey line, no push, never unread; text KALMIDO_NOTICE_COMPACTED, default 'Conversation compacted (HH:MM)'); a host that starts a fresh session with a summary of the old one sends one too; older servers (400 / 404) get nothing, never a normal message
